forces.title: Consumers increase spending on diverse wellness categories.
forces.description: Consumers are increasingly expanding their spending across a wider range of wellness categories beyond traditional offerings, including nutrition, weight loss solutions, fitness experiences, and general wellness services. This shift is driven by a more holistic definition of wellbeing, encompassing cardiovascular health, healthy aging, stress management, and mental health, creating significant demand for IN060702 and IN060703 products/services.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: GLP-1 adoption drives demand for adjacent wellness products.
forces.description: GLP-1 adoption is creating attractive opportunities for consumer health brands to acquire new customers. Consumers navigating weight loss, particularly with GLP-1s, are highly receptive to adjacent wellness products and services supporting broader health goals such as fitness, nutrition, recovery, and coaching. This includes adapting product portfolios and content strategies to cater to changing body compositions and new fitness activities, aligning with IN060702 and IN060703 offerings.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: AI increasingly influences consumer health product discovery.
forces.description: Consumers are fundamentally changing how they discover products, moving from specific product searches to broader, holistic questions that AI is well-suited to answer (e.g., "What gear do I need for a marathon?"). With 36% of US consumers using AI for shopping and over 50% for wellness occasions, AI is becoming a critical platform for brand discovery, especially for younger demographics like Gen Z. This necessitates new strategies for brands to ensure visibility within AI-generated recommendations.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: GLP-1 market evolution and diverse consumer purchase archetypes.
forces.description: The GLP-1 market is evolving with new formats and indications, with access expanding through commercial coverage and digital platforms (e.g., Lilly's Foundayo). This evolution is creating distinct consumer purchase archetypes: lifestyle optimization, aesthetic transformation, disease management, and 'all-in' on GLP-1s. These archetypes highlight diverse needs, driving demand for tailored wellness, supplements, and functional food products (IN060702, IN060703) in the consumer health market.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: GLP-1s boost demand for functional foods and supplements.
forces.description: GLP-1 users significantly shift their food spending towards fresh produce, protein, fiber, and other functional products, while decreasing consumption of less healthy options. This behavior drives increased demand for meal replacement shakes, functional gut health beverages, high-protein foods, and fruits/vegetables. Similarly, protein, fiber, and collagen supplements show the highest spending growth among GLP-1 users, directly benefiting the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals (IN060702) segment.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: Post-GLP-1 cessation support creates new wellness opportunities.
forces.description: A significant portion of GLP-1 users are lapsed or cycle on/off, with two-thirds of lapsed users planning to restart. This creates an opportunity for consumer health brands to develop wellness, supplements, aesthetics, and apparel products and services tailored for the "lapsed-users" cohort. Brands can focus on supporting unique needs during on- and off-ramp periods, ensuring post-lapse stickiness and continued engagement within IN060702 and IN060703 offerings.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: Community pharmacies expand role in primary care, boosting demand.
forces.description: Community pharmacy in Ireland is undergoing a significant evolution, with pharmacists' clinical role expanding through initiatives like the Common Conditions Service and the Community Pharmacy Agreement. This strengthens their position as a key component of primary care, driving increased prescription medicine values and volumes, and growing demand for chronic disease management and enhanced clinical services within the OTC Medicines & Self-Medication (IN060701) segment.
forces.source_title: Bank of Ireland Healthcare Sector H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook July 2026

forces.title: Consolidation and investor confidence fuel Irish pharmacy growth.
forces.description: Ireland's community pharmacy sector is experiencing active M&A, with 98 pharmacy transactions completed between 2023 and 2025. This consolidation reflects robust investor confidence and attractive long-term sector fundamentals, driven by favorable demographics and a shift towards community-based care models. Operators with modern infrastructure and access to capital are well-positioned to capitalize on future growth opportunities through acquisitions and scale within IN060701.
forces.source_title: Bank of Ireland Healthcare Sector H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook July 2026

forces.title: Ireland's aging population sustains long-term healthcare demand.
forces.description: Long-term demographic trends, specifically Ireland's aging population, increased life expectancy, and rising incidence of chronic disease, continue to underpin sustained demand across the entire healthcare sector. This structural driver creates a resilient investment environment and supports continued growth for consumer health products and services, particularly those focused on chronic disease management, self-medication (IN060701), and wellness/longevity (IN060703) in community settings.
forces.source_title: Bank of Ireland Healthcare Sector H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook July 2026

viewpoints.title: Expanding wellness economy offers significant growth avenues for consumer health brands.
viewpoints.description: The global wellness economy is projected to grow 8% annually through 2030, outpacing many discretionary categories. This expansion creates strong tailwinds for brands in the consumer health sector. Companies can capitalize by engaging consumers at key life stages, building credibility in adjacent wellness areas like nutrition and weight loss, and adapting to new discovery channels like AI-driven recommendations. This holistic view of wellness offers a larger ecosystem of products and services beyond traditional offerings for IN060702 and IN060703.
viewpoints.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

viewpoints.title: Ireland's community pharmacy sector shows positive long-term growth and resilience.
viewpoints.description: The community pharmacy sector in Ireland is undergoing a significant evolution, supported by strong demographic demand and government investment. Prescription medicine values increased by 9.5% in H1 2026, driven by chronic disease management and expanded clinical services. The implementation of the Community Pharmacy Agreement and the Common Conditions Service are strengthening pharmacists' roles in primary care, indicating robust investor confidence and attractive long-term fundamentals for pharmacy-led health management (IN060701).
viewpoints.source_title: Bank of Ireland Healthcare Sector H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook July 2026
